newsitem.title: UK: Tokyo holiday deadens Japan stocks in London.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo holiday deadens Japan stocks in London.

text.p: Trading in Japanese stocks in London was at a virtual standstill on Thursday after the Tokyo stock market closed for a one-day national holiday.
"The market's pretty flat with little new money coming in...We have seen some interest in Nippon Oil and Tokyo Gas but otherwise, it's been quiet," one trader said.
The Nikkei/Ise 50 index shed 0.2 point to 1,425.48.
Traders said the market was likely to open slightly weaker on Friday with political worries taking the edge off investor interest ahead of the November 20 general elections in Japan.
